description: This file is a Streamlit application script for generating and practicing medical exam questions. It includes UI components for configuration, question generation via an agent, and a practice mode with navigation and answer validation.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent responsible for generating batches of questions based on specified parameters.

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a batch of questions for a given chapter, count, difficulty, and image inclusion.
